description: This Java class 'BCKeyAndCertificateFactory' implements key and certificate generation, loading, and management for TLS using BouncyCastle. It handles creation and storage of CA and leaf certificates, private keys, and certificate chains, with dynamic update capabilities.

classes.name: BCKeyAndCertificateFactory
classes.description: Implements key and certificate management for TLS, including creation, loading, and chain building, using BouncyCastle.

methods.name: buildAndSaveCertificateAuthorityPrivateKeyAndX509Certificate
methods.description: Generates and saves CA private key and X509 certificate if not already created or if dynamic update is enabled.

methods.name: certificateAuthorityPrivateKeyPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the CA private key PEM file, updating configuration if dynamic.

methods.name: certificateAuthorityPrivateKey
methods.description: Loads the CA private key from PEM file, generating if necessary.

methods.name: certificateAuthorityX509CertificatePath
methods.description: Returns the path to the CA X509 certificate PEM file, updating configuration if dynamic.

methods.name: certificateAuthorityX509Certificate
methods.description: Loads the CA X509 certificate from PEM file, generating if necessary.

methods.name: generateCACert
methods.description: Creates a self-signed CA X509 certificate with specified algorithm and keys.

methods.name: buildAndSavePrivateKeyAndX509Certificate
methods.description: Generates and saves leaf private key and certificate, or loads existing if provided.

methods.name: privateKeyPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the leaf private key PEM file, updating configuration.

methods.name: privateKey
methods.description: Loads the leaf private key from PEM file or returns the in-memory key if provided.

methods.name: x509CertificatePath
methods.description: Returns the path to the leaf certificate PEM file, updating configuration.

methods.name: x509Certificate
methods.description: Loads the leaf X509 certificate from PEM file or returns the in-memory certificate if provided.

methods.name: generateLeafCert
methods.description: Creates a signed leaf certificate with specified subject, SANs, and issuer.

methods.name: signCertificate
methods.description: Signs a certificate builder with a private key to produce an X509 certificate.

methods.name: createSubjectKeyIdentifier
methods.description: Creates a SubjectKeyIdentifier extension from a public key.

methods.name: certificateNotYetCreated
methods.description: Checks if the leaf certificate has not been created or loaded.

methods.name: customPrivateKeyAndCertificateProvided
methods.description: Determines if custom private key and certificate paths are provided.

methods.name: dynamicallyUpdateCertificateAuthority
methods.description: Checks if CA certificate should be dynamically created/updated.

methods.name: certificateAuthorityCertificateNotYetCreated
methods.description: Checks if the CA certificate PEM file exists and is valid.
